subject: Taxes
title: The Cayman Islands
description: A quick win: understand The Cayman Islands.

hook.text: The Cayman Islands has zero income tax, zero corporate tax, and zero capital gains tax.

buildup.text: One building—Ugland House—is the registered address of 18,857 companies.

discovery.text: The Caymans is the world's fifth-largest financial center by assets. Over $1 trillion flows through its banks.

twist.text: Most 'companies' registered there have no employees or offices.

climax.text: The Caymans shows that in a digital world, companies don't need to be where they're registered.

punchline.text: 18,857 companies, one building. The Cayman Islands' paper empire.

quiz.question: How many companies are registered at Ugland House in the Cayman Islands?
